note: Applied by the build only to specific-energy-consumption rows with target steam given as a mass (kg or t of steam per unit of product), never through applies-to. MOST COMMON CHARACTERISTICS (modeller 2026-10-02): industrial process steam is most often saturated at about 7-12 bar; the sources here cite 7, 8, 9 and 10 bar, so 10 bar(a) saturated is the central value and 5-20 bar the range. Energy counted as the steam's full enthalpy above 0 degC water, not net of returned condensate: net of condensate at 105 degC (h 440 kJ/kg) it would be 2.34 GJ/t, so a source whose steam energy is net of condensate return is about 16% lower than this basis.
